title: Fitflix: Performance, Engineered
content: Fitflix is an elite, biotech-integrated wellness club and performance training gym ecosystem operating in Hyderabad and Bengaluru. Combining architectural spaces, high-end biomechanical equipment, clinical recovery modalities, and DNA-guided programming, Fitflix bridges the gap between athletic conditioning, longevity, and clinical medicine. The ecosystem brings doctors, physiotherapists, clinical nutritionists, and elite coaches together into one coherent team built around the member's biology.

title: The Fitflix Method: Measure First. Then Train.
content:
Fitflix operates on a proprietary, three-phase continuous improvement methodology:
1. Phase 01: Assess — DNA analysis, ActiveX body composition metrics (BCA), and a 45-minute 1-on-1 consultation establish a clinical baseline.
2. Phase 02: Optimize — A personalized biological protocol spanning strength training, clinical nutrition, cold immersion, radiant heat, and red-light photobiomodulation.
3. Phase 03: Perform — AI-assisted recommendations calibrate training volume, recovery timing, and nutrition month-after-month as telemetry updates.

title: Cold Plunge Therapy
content: Submerge your body in cold water held between 8°C and 15°C for 2 to 5 minutes of focused cold exposure within a 20-minute private appointment slot. Guided cold immersion rapidly constricts blood vessels to flush metabolic waste and systemic inflammation, triggers norepinephrine release for immediate focus, lifts mood, and conditions the autonomic nervous system toward stress resilience.

title: Whole-Body Cryotherapy Chamber (-110°C)
content: Exposes the body to hyper-cooled dry air at -110°C for 2 to 4 minutes within a 3-minute booking slot. The extreme temperature stimulates systemic vasoconstriction, followed by rapid vasodilation upon exit. This accelerates deep muscular repair, suppresses chronic joint pain, stimulates endorphin release, and boosts post-workout metabolic rate.

title: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT)
content: Breathe pure medical-grade oxygen inside a specialized pressurized chamber for 60 minutes. Pressurized oxygen dissolves directly into blood plasma, cerebral spinal fluid, and lymph, allowing oxygen to reach damaged tissues up to 4x deeper than normal atmospheric conditions. HBOT accelerates cellular repair, reduces neuroinflammation, promotes angiogenesis, and expedites soft-tissue trauma healing.

title: Pursuit 03: Absolute Strength Training Ecosystem
content:
Absolute Strength is Fitflix's progressive strength and hypertrophy ecosystem engineered for long-term physical performance.

Ethos:
'Strength is a discipline. Not a workout — a practice. Progressive overload, intelligent programming, and elite coaching converge here to build a body that performs for decades, not seasons.'

Six Core Disciplines:
1. Olympic Weightlifting (Snatch, clean & jerk, barbell cycling)
2. Powerlifting (Squat, bench, deadlift under calibrated plates)
3. Functional Hypertrophy (Muscle building with biomechanical machines)
4. Kettlebell Mastery (Ballistic power, rotational strength)
5. Strongman Conditioning (Yoke carries, sled pushes, farmer walks)
6. Advanced Calisthenics (Strict bodyweight leverage, gymnastic rings)

The Method:
- Assess: Baseline lifting mechanics, force velocity profiles, and movement asymmetries.
- Program: Periodized, volume-managed loading cycles.
- Calibrate: Weekly adjustments based on recovery metrics.

Personal Training:
Option for 1-on-1 dedicated coach assignment, private coaching suite access, and weekly biometric recalibrations.
eligibility_or_conditions: All fitness levels welcome; baseline assessment determines load.
notes_or_missing_information: Public preview available in Flutter app without sign-in.

title: Pursuit 01: Longevity & Vitality Ecosystem
content:

Philosophy:
'Longevity is built in recovery. Performance is earned in training — but it is preserved in recovery. Our club brings clinical-grade therapies under one calm, futuristic roof, so the body repairs faster, ages slower, and lives more luminously.'

Signature 75-Minute Recovery Ritual:
A sequenced multi-modality protocol where therapies compound:
1. 20 min Radiant Infrared Heat (elevates core temperature, vasodilation)
2. 3 min Cryotherapy or 5 min Cold Plunge (systemic anti-inflammatory flush)
3. 20 min Red Light Sauna (mitochondrial rejuvenation, ATP synthesis)
4. 25 min NormaTec Compression & Hydration (lymphatic clearance)

The Longevity Lab:
Bespoke diagnostic protocols including intravenous (IV) micronutrient therapy, physician-prescribed peptide therapies, and continuous blood biomarker tracking.

title: Precision Clinical Nutrition & Dietitian Coaching
content:

- DNA-Guided Nutrition: Nutrient absorption, caffeine clearance rates, and methylated B-vitamin requirements mapped directly from genomic swabs.
- Master Energy Target: Macro targets calibrated against a standardized daily 2,500 kcal baseline indicator.
- Mandatory Daily Guidelines: 1 designated target raw salad (MUST-Salad) and 4 tsp visible healthy oil allowance evenly distributed across daily meals.
- In-App Telemetry: Daily meal logs across breakfast, lunch, snack, and dinner slots, water intake tracker (2,500 ml baseline with +250ml/+500ml quick-adds), and visual macro breakdowns for Protein, Carbohydrates, and Fats.

title: Clinical DNA Profiling & Biotech Performance Blueprint
content:
A one-time saliva test delivering a lifetime genomic blueprint for training and nutrition.

4-Step Laboratory Workflow:
1. Request the Kit: Clinical-grade saliva collection kit hand-couriered overnight.
2. Extract & Return: Simple non-invasive saliva swab returned in a sealed, prepaid, temperature-controlled envelope.
3. Genomic Sequencing: CLIA-certified partner laboratory sequences over 100 actionable markers spanning performance, metabolism, inflammation, and recovery.
4. Blueprint Delivery: Personalized genomic protocol delivered directly into the Fitflix member dashboard.

Actionable Insights:
- Precision Nutrition: Macronutrient clearance, caffeine metabolism speed (e.g. 1.6x baseline fast metabolizer), lactose, and B-vitamin methylation.
- Hypertrophic Response: Fast-twitch vs slow-twitch muscle fiber expression to determine optimal repetition ranges and training volume.
- Injury Predisposition: Tendon and ligament collagen tensile strength, baseline inflammatory response, and joint recovery duration.

Data Privacy Commitment:
Genomic data is encrypted, strictly confidential, used solely to calibrate personal fitness/diet protocols, never shared or sold to third parties, and eligible for permanent deletion upon member request.
price_and_currency: Included in High-Tier Memberships / Standalone Lab Kit Fee
eligibility_or_conditions: Saliva kit delivered upon request; test is taken once in a lifetime.

title: Fitflix Membership Architecture & Pricing Framework
content:
Fitflix organizes memberships into structured tiers backed by a credits and sessions model:

Plan Categories:
1. GENERAL_MEMBERSHIP: Full access to strength floors, locker rooms, daily class schedule, and app tracking.
2. PERSONAL_TRAINING: Includes dedicated 1-on-1 personal training sessions with elite coaches.
3. THERAPY_PACK: Bundles of credits dedicated to recovery modalities (Cryo, Cold Plunge, HBOT, Red Light).
4. CREDIT_PACK: Flexible top-up credit pools to book specialty therapies or guest sessions on demand.

Commercial Specifications:
- Currency: Indian Rupee (INR).
- Tax: Subject to 18% GST (SAC code 999723).
- Durations: Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual terms (with day-level granularity supported in backend).
- Multi-Club Passport: Every membership is valid for workouts across all three physical gyms in Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
- Presale / Founding Members: Special discounted founding rates are made available for new clubs before grand opening.
- Final Pricing Transparency: Specific plan rates are finalized during the prospective member's private consultation call.
eligibility_or_conditions: Standard memberships require initial 45-minute consultation; renewal available via app.
notes_or_missing_information: Backend endpoint: GET /membership-plans. Membership plans can be branch-specific or company-wide.

title: FAQ: Is my DNA data private?
content:
Question: Is my DNA data private?
Answer: Yes. Your genetic report is utilized strictly to personalize your training, recovery, and nutrition protocols. It is never sold, leased, or shared with advertisers or third parties, and you can request the permanent deletion of your biological data from our servers at any time.
notes_or_missing_information: Core objection-handling for prospective members hesitant about genetics.

title: FAQ: What happens in the consultation?
content:
Question: What happens in the consultation?
Answer: You spend 45 minutes with a dedicated Fitflix specialist reviewing your personal goals, training history, lifestyle constraints, and available health metrics. You leave the session with a clear, actionable picture of the custom training and recovery plan we would build for your body — with absolutely no obligation to join.
